notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §5.3, §9.4; review A probe P8): the only declaration of a human key is self-attested (structural, no other signature, untrusted). A note signed by that key with a signature whose equation fails is not verified against that declaration's material: a signature on a record other than a declaration or the manifest needs a trusted or semantically valid declaration, so the signature is unverified and the note unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN with N_KEY_UNDECLARED, not invalid E_SIG_INVALID.
